name: ensure_cost_derived_fresh
doc:
V1 `checkTPSLPreValid` / `checkInputFocus` for the TPSL advanced entry, lowered
to Rust so the readiness DECISION (which box is empty, which toast, tick error)
is the single source of truth (A1). Pure query (interactor-spec §C, no state
mutation): mirrors the first three branches of `pre_check_order`'s pre-flight —
empty price (unless BBO) -> empty amount(sz) -> amount tick-size error — but
injects the cost-aware entry toast on the empty branches (V1
`getTPSLPreValidMessage`) and returns `toast: None` for the tick branch so Kotlin
calls `showCorrectValue`. Kotlin performs only the UI side-effect (focus +
toast/showCorrectValue), never the decision. `input` is the same representative
order input the advance sheet already builds (Kotlin
`buildContractLimitOrderInput(isBuy = true)`), so `req.sz` is derived identically
to submit (no gate/submit drift, correct in cost mode too).
Cost mode: recompute `cost_derived_size` via the EXISTING cascade if it is empty while a
cost is entered (the cascade dep -- leverage / deal_price -- may have settled AFTER the
last input-triggered recompute). Reuses `recompute_cost_mode` (same formula, no drift);
no-op in amount mode / when already derived. Called at the gate + submit so the sz
reflects the current cost (device recvqnnXvx6KW4).

`OrderPreCheckResp` is a serde-deserialize wire type, not a UniFFI Record,
and it carries ~30 fields. State must be a `#[interactor::state]` UniFFI
type, so the interactor projects only the margin-confirm-relevant subset
here. Every field stays a RAW string (server convention) — the
`DisplayString` / `TradingNumber` formatting (A4 HalfUp, symbol/sign) is
applied at b016 (`orchestration::confirm`) when shaping the display rows.

All fields mirror `OrderPreCheckResp` 1:1 (same name, raw string). The
`change_*` siblings are the "after-order" values; the bare names are the
"before-order" values — i.e. the before/after pairs the margin confirm
sheet renders (Positions Total, Liability, MMR/IMR check).

manager — A1 re-parent shares the session, never creates a new one;
design §3.1) AND — A (side fix) — handing the panel the container's

container-driven side switches flow Rust parent -> child instead of
through the Kotlin global tab (single-track: the panel no longer needs
the native `update_side` push). Mirrors

passes `None` (no container shell, side keeps coming from the native
tab). Supersedes the earlier B2 "create-routing only" shape (no
session / no side watch) now that advanced-limit self-reads its
session-derived data.
